messages:
anna_support: Hey team — customer 'OneTeamApp' just reported spike of 401s from their canary after a key rotation. They rotated their HSM signing key used to mint service JWTs. Can we triage?

ben_engineering: Can you paste an example curl + response?

anna_support: Here's the curl from their canary pod (sanitized):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt-from-sidecar>" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/featureX
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 17:02:30 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"invalid_token", "error_description":"signature verification failed (kid not found)"}
```

diane_sre: :eyes: "kid not found" suggests the downstream JWKS cache doesn't have the new key id (kid). Are they hitting our CDN or a local verification cache?

anna_support: They go through an internal auth-proxy sidecar that signs the JWTs, and requests terminate at our edge verifier which uses a cached JWKS from the customer's private JWK endpoint (customer hosts JWKS behind their VPC endpoint). They rotated HSM key and updated JWKS but maybe our cache still has old list.

chris_oncall: Any logs from the edge verifier?

ben_engineering: Found this from edge verifier logs around the same time: 
```
[2026-02-24T17:01:58Z] verifier: incoming token kid=old-kid-abc123
[2026-02-24T17:01:58Z] verifier: jwks cache miss for kid old-kid-abc123, attempted fetch -> 200 OK but jwks does not contain kid
[2026-02-24T17:01:58Z] verifier: token verification failed: kid not found
```

diane_sre: Interesting — cache miss then fetch returns JWKS that doesn't include old-kid (makes sense if they replaced key). But why is sidecar still producing tokens with old-kid? That points to the sidecar not reloading the signing material after the rotation.

anna_support: Customer says they rotated using their HSM management console which created new key (kid new-kid-987) and set it as active. Sidecar logs: 
```
sidecar-auth: loaded signing key kid=old-kid-abc123 at 2026-02-24T16:55:00Z
sidecar-auth: key refresh check next in 600s
```

ben_engineering: Ah — sidecar polls JWKS every 10 minutes in this deployment and doesn't watch HSM events. If they did an in-place rotation, there's a window where sidecars still have the old key and will sign with it. The verifier fetches JWKS, sees only new-kid, and rejects old-key tokens -> 401.

chris_oncall: Mitigation steps we can suggest to customer:
- Reconfigure sidecar to read JWKS from their KMS-wrapping service or push a refresh to the sidecar (we can trigger a rollout).
- Manually restart sidecar pods in canary to pick up new key now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/one-team-sidecar -n canary`
- If they want zero-downtime rotations, add the new key to JWKS before switching active signing key, keep both keys for overlap.

anna_support: They did ask for a zero-downtime pattern; they thought HSM set active key immediately. I'll pass that along. Also they want a short repro so their infra can validate.

ben_engineering: Repro steps we sent to the customer (short):
1) In a staging cluster, configure sidecar to poll JWKS every 10m.
2) Deploy sidecar -> it signs a token with `old-kid`.
3) Rotate key in HSM: create new key (new-kid) and update JWKS to return only `new-kid`.
4) Call endpoint with token signed by `old-kid` -> expect 401 `kid not found`.

diane_sre: Quick commands to validate locally (they can run from a bastion):
```
# get token from sidecar
kubectl exec -it pod/sidecar-123 -n canary -- sh -c 'curl -s http://localhost:8080/token' > token.jwt
# verify kid in token
python -c "import jwt,sys; print(jwt.get_unverified_header(open('token.jwt').read()))"
# hit API
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat token.jwt)" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/featureX -v
```

chris_oncall: Also recommended: set sidecar to hot-reload keys on SIGHUP or expose a /reload endpoint they can call from their key rotation pipeline. That avoids pod restarts.

anna_support: Customer did a restart of 2 canary pods and reports success for those pods. They want guidance for full rollout safe strategy.

ben_engineering: Documented best-practice we sent: publish new public JWK entry first (keep old JWKs), update sidecar config to start using new-kid (or allow dual signing), then once all signing entities have shifted, retire old key after TTL. Also add a cache-busting header for edge JWKS fetch during rotation pipeline: `?v=<rotation_ts>`.

vault-bot: Vault: detected access to path `secret/one-team/jwks` at 2026-02-24T17:00:45Z by service-account `one-team-rotator`.

diane_sre: For our internal product note: we should add a rotation playbook to support KB with step-by-step (restart vs reload, example SIGHUP hook) and an alert when verifier sees repeated kid-not-found errors correlated with key creation events. I'll file a follow-up.

anna_support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with restart + best-practice and keep this thread open until they confirm full rollout passes. :thumbsup:
